subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If an effective implementation mapping or native-profile qualification is found defective after production activation, then the system shall engage FR-26 for new work, stop new affected claims, append EVT-11 marking every affected in-flight or unaccepted attempt `rerun_required`, preserve unaffected work, and require replacement evidence on the exact affected task/proposal revision; for already accepted artifacts, preserve shipped state and emit an operator remediation brief without destructive rollback
intent: exact policy/profile versions, attempts, tasks, proposals, revisions, and disposition are named; affected open work cannot be accepted until replacement evidence passes
fit_criterion: a seeded defect marks every affected open attempt non-evidentiary, permits unaffected work to continue, reruns the exact affected revision successfully, and produces one complete operator brief for an accepted artifact without mutating it
